name: 曜日別の丸い棒グラフ
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: one Japanese Lighthouse catalog component LH17-0001, 曜日別の丸い棒グラフ.
Create ONE polished straight-on raster UI candidate, preserving the actual content and geometry of input 1. It is an isolated seven-day chart, not a full dashboard or phone screenshot. Landscape aspect ratio about 390:272, rendered crisply at high resolution. Pure white #FFFFFF canvas and white rounded card, subtle fine neutral edge and very soft downward elevation. Tight purposeful composition, readable labels, no added title or actions.
Input images: Image 1 = our native saved component preview, sole authority for Japanese labels, bar values, layout and visible state. Image 2 = original Fitbit screenshot, evidence for rounded bar silhouettes and target-line semantics only; do not import the surrounding English screen, app navigation, watermark or unrelated data. Image 3 = owner-approved bus direction, style only for restrained white surfaces, smooth forest green depth and fine elevation; no bus/map content. Image 4 = owner-selected statistics style, typography hierarchy only; do not copy its mint panel or numbers.
Exact component: horizontal target line across plot at label 10,000. Right-aligned value axis labels exactly 10,000 / 6,700 / 3,300 / 0. Seven weekday labels exactly 日 月 火 水 木 金 土 below matching marks. First five marks are tiny rounded horizontal low bars at baseline. Friday is a short capsule about one fifth the full plot height; Saturday a tall capsule about four fifths the plot height, retaining native preview proportions. Do not turn the tiny bars into taller fabricated values. Do not add numerical tooltips, legend, metric header, unit, period controls, buttons or labels. Keep all seven marks, the target line and all axis labels fully visible with no overlap.
Typography: Meiryo Regular, established logical body14/24 and metadata12/16, zero tracking. Preserve role sizes relative to a390px-wide component; do not make labels bold. Text dark readable neutral, secondary #6E6E6E. Preserve Japanese glyphs verbatim.
Color decision: original teal encodes one actual data series and its target, with no categorical accent. Adapt all seven chart bars coherently to forest green #1F6444, gently shaded #174C36 to #2D8F5E on larger capsules. The target line uses a quiet green in the same series. No extra accent hue, rainbow icons, mint wash, glow or plastic gloss. Keep supporting labels neutral. Apple Design: visual clarity, compact grouping, careful baseline alignment and restrained materials. This is a static design candidate only.
reviewNotes: 原画・日本語モック・正式バス方向・会員統計例を目視。原画の単一ティール系列と目標線を統一した森林緑へ適応。生成出力を目視し、日月火水木金土の7表示、10,000/6,700/3,300/0、前半5本の微小棒と金土の比率、白面と柔らかな影、欠落やクリップなしを確認。余分な指標・操作なし。フォントの正確な実体、所有者承認、ネイティブ編集可能性、アプリ実装は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
